news.title: New major risk - Share price stability
news.body: The company's share price has been highly volatile over the past 3 months. It is more volatile than 90% of Indian stocks, typically moving 10% a week. This is considered a major risk. Share price volatility increases the risk of potential losses in the short-term as the stock tends to have larger drops in price more frequently than other stocks. It may also indicate the stock is highly sensitive to market conditions or economic conditions rather than being sensitive to its own business performance, which may also be inconsistent. news.title: Third quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹1.50 loss per share (vs ₹1.65 loss in 3Q 2025)
news.body: Third quarter 2026 results: ₹1.50 loss per share (improved from ₹1.65 loss in 3Q 2025). Revenue: ₹47.3m (up 9.0% from 3Q 2025). Net loss: ₹22.5m (loss narrowed 9.2% from 3Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 34% per year whereas the company’s share price has increased by 33% per year.

news.title: Second quarter 2026 earnings released: ₹2.10 loss per share (vs ₹6.30 loss in 2Q 2025)
news.body: Second quarter 2026 results: ₹2.10 loss per share (improved from ₹6.30 loss in 2Q 2025). Revenue: ₹30.4m (flat on 2Q 2025). Net loss: ₹31.5m (flat on 2Q 2025). Over the last 3 years on average, earnings per share has increased by 23% per year but the company’s share price has increased by 44% per year, which means it is tracking significantly ahead of earnings growth.
